_comment: `a.js` defers `d.js`, and the entry imports `d.js` eagerly after `a.js`. `d.js` comes before `a.js` in chunk order, so its import of `w.js` is the first import of `w.js` in chunk order, but `d.js` runs late. The import in the entry starts `w.js`, so its init call moves before `a.js`: `w` before `a`, as in native order.
